{{Top|leg}}
'''Gundark-skin''' was a material taken from a [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]]. It could be used as a material to construct bags such as [[Backpack/Legends|backpacks]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Luke's Backpack|backpack]], which travelled with him to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], was made of gundark-skin.<ref name="CCG-Backpack">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Luke's Backpack}}</ref>
